newsitem.title: USA: GOLF-OLAZABAL ACCEPTS INVITE TO PLAY IN ANDERSEN CHAMPIONSHIP.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-OLAZABAL ACCEPTS INVITE TO PLAY IN ANDERSEN CHAMPIONSHIP.

text.p: Jose Maria Olazabal, who recently returned to play on the European Tour after an 18-month layoff, has accepted a berth in the European competition for the Andersen Consulting world championship of golf, organisers said Wednesday.
The 1994 Masters champion from Spain will square off against European number one Colin Montgomerie of Britain in the first round of the worldwide match play tournament.
The 31-year-old Olazabal, sidelined by painful foot problems apparently brought on by a lower back hernia, is a 15-time European Tour winner and six-time winner outside the continent.

The European competition, to be held at Buckinghamshire Golf Club in Denham, England, on May 19-20, will feature the following matches (prefix denotes seeding): 1-Colin Montgomerie (Britain) vs 8-Jose Maria Olazabal (Spain) 2-Bernhard Langer (Germany) vs 7-Darren Clarke (Ireland) 4-Ian Woosnam (Britain) vs 5-Sam Torrance (Britain) 3-Costantino Rocca (Italy) vs 6-Jesper Parnevik (Sweden)
